successCriteria.description: Define `LeaveRequest` interface in `src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` with all specified attributes: id, employeeId, leaveTypeId, startDate, endDate, reason, status (LeaveStatus enum), approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason, cancelledBy, cancelledAt, cancellationReason, createdAt, updatedAt
Define `CreateLeaveRequestDto` with fields: employeeId (required), leaveTypeId (required), startDate (required), endDate (required), reason (optional)

Define `UpdateLeaveRequestDto` as a Partial-like type for status/reason fields (e.g., status, approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason, cancelledBy, cancelledAt, cancellationReason)
Define `LeaveRequestQueryParams` with optional filters: employeeId, status (LeaveStatus), date range (startDate, endDate)

Define `ILeaveRepository` interface with methods: findById(id: string): Promise<LeaveRequest | null>, findByEmployeeId(employeeId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>, findByStatus(status: LeaveStatus): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>, create(dto: CreateLeaveRequestDto): Promise<LeaveRequest>, update(id: string, dto: UpdateLeaveRequestDto): Promise<LeaveRequest | null>, delete(id: string): Promise<boolean>
Implement `LeaveRepository` class that implements `ILeaveRepository` using the pg Pool from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` for all database operations
Include Jest unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.repository.test.ts` that mock the pg Pool and verify all repository methods

constraints: All database access must go through the repository pattern (GP-001) — the `LeaveRepository` class is the sole point of database interaction for leave requests
No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards where needed (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`)
Strict TypeScript: no implicit any, strict null checks (from HARNESS.json stack description)
The model file must import `LeaveStatus` from `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts` — no redefinition of the enum
The repository must import the pg Pool from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` — no alternative database connection
outOfScope: Controller and routes (`leave.controller.ts`, `leave.routes.ts`, `index.ts`) — deferred to Phase 4
Audit record creation on state-changing operations — GP-002 applies but audit implementation is deferred to a later phase or handled by the service layer in Phase 3
RBAC enforcement — deferred to controller/routes layer in Phase 4 (GP-005)
Input validation at API boundaries — deferred to controller layer in Phase 4 (GP-003)
Database migrations (Knex) for the leave_requests table — not mentioned in this phase
Business logic validation (date ordering, status transition rules) — deferred to service layer in Phase 3
Policy, Balance, Notification, or Employee modules — deferred to Phases 5–9

ambiguities.description: The `leaveTypeId` field in `LeaveRequest` and `CreateLeaveRequestDto` — is this a string foreign key (UUID referencing a `leave_types` table) or the `LeaveType` enum value from `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts`? The "Id" suffix suggests a foreign key, but the shared types define `LeaveType` as an enum and the policy module (Phase 5) uses `leaveType: LeaveType` directly. This affects type declarations and repository query logic.
options: Treat leaveTypeId as a string (UUID foreign key to a leave_types table)
Treat leaveTypeId as the LeaveType enum value directly

ambiguities.description: The exact fields of `UpdateLeaveRequestDto` — described as "Partial of status/reason fields" but which fields exactly? Candidates include: status, approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason, cancelledBy, cancelledAt, cancellationReason. Should all be optional? Should any be grouped (e.g., rejection fields must be set together)?
options: Grouped: rejection fields (rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason) must be set together, same for approval and cancellation groups

ambiguities.description: The `delete` method return type is unspecified. Should it return `Promise<boolean>` (success indicator), `Promise<void>` (fire-and-forget), or `Promise<LeaveRequest | null>` (the deleted entity)?
options: Promise<boolean> — true if a row was deleted, false if not found
Promise<LeaveRequest | null> — return the deleted entity or null

ambiguities.description: The `LeaveRequestQueryParams` date range — should it be two separate optional fields (`startDate` and `endDate` as filter boundaries) or a single range object? The intent says "date range" without specifying the structure.
options: Two separate optional Date fields: startDate and endDate
A single optional range object: { from: Date; to: Date }
